findings.finding: The discovery-view, opportunity, fingerprint, motif, family, functional-core, restricted AST, evaluation, control and legacy-benchmark preparation is deterministic and internally complete on synthetic fixtures.
Outcome, future, profitability, Validation, semantic and legacy-seed fields are technically blocked from discovery dependencies.
Synthetic opportunity and evaluation populations reconcile exactly, and every negative result remains addressable.
Motifs, families, functional cores and rule candidates remain provisional, inactive, noncanonical and semantically neutral.
Matched controls use exact registered strata and duration bins with no nearest, best or fallback selection.
Legacy rules are isolated to post-discovery benchmark comparison and have zero seed, filter, score, stop or promotion effect.
The repository-accessible full-month manifest is bound to legacy active C2 v1 rather than the revised vNext SHADOW_FROZEN pipeline.
The legacy manifest lists external payloads, but their bytes are not repository-accessible and therefore the population cannot be independently reproduced here.
No content-addressed revised vNext full replay manifest, complete payload, clean-run hash pair or capacity/restart receipt is available.
Synthetic evidence cannot support real market functional-candidate, rule-candidate, legacy-benchmark or research-consumer dispositions.
Active C2 and all selector, event, episode, semantic, outcome, publication, Validation and execution authorities remain unchanged.

acceptance_conditions.condition: Complete registered discovery opportunity population, denominator ledger and deterministic method pack reconcile with no legacy-rule or outcome leakage.
Every retained functional and rule candidate has exact real-population lineage, controls, counterexamples, stability and first-valid evidence.
Every method, functional candidate, rule candidate and legacy benchmark mapping can receive an operator disposition.
No selector, C2E, C2.5, C3, outcome, Validation or exposure authority is activated.

recommendation_rationale: The reusable bottom-up machinery passes, but the gate cannot lawfully evaluate or disposition methods and candidates without the exact complete revised vNext population. Substituting legacy, synthetic, sampled or manifest-only evidence would violate the approved plan.
rollback: Preserve the branch, synthetic proof, QA and blocker. Do not merge or admit the method candidate. Active C2 remains unchanged.
